research:
Lines (ESPN DK pickcenter): DET -1.5 (-115) / MIA +1.5 (-105), ML DET -115 / MIA -105, total 235.5 (o -110 / u -110). SI had DK 237.5 earlier; Bleacher Nation 236.5; SportsGambler opened DET +2.5 at 236.5. Total has come down.
Injuries (ESPN): DET Taurean Prince day-to-day (personal). MIA none listed; Adebayo played 31 min in the opener after groin tightness.
Openers (ESPN box): DET beat BOS 121-113 (Cade 22/4/8 in 35 min, Duren 22/9, D. Robinson 21 in 28 min, A. Thompson 11/11/5). MIA lost 131-106 to MIN (Giannis 35/6/1 on 13-19, Adebayo 15/7/4, D. Mitchell 11 ast).
Usage (BBR 2025-26, blended with one game): Giannis 37.0% (MIL), Cade 30.5%, Adebayo 25.0%. Duren 23.6% just misses.
DvP: MIA allowed the 3rd-most guard fantasy points (own 2025-26 calc), so Cade qualifies. DET was 4th in opp ppg (109.7) with an elite rim defense, so Giannis/Adebayo fail the gate.
Cade 2025-26 ladder (64 g): 10+ pts 95.3%, 2+ reb 93.8%, 6+ ast 93.8%, 7+ ast 90.6%, 9+ ast 68.8%, 20+ pts 68.8%. Those deep rungs are not bet; real lines only per the 10/22 rule.
Props found: Cade o24.5 pts (SportsGambler line, price not found for tonight), Cade ast 9.5 o +115 / u -156 (SportsGambler); Giannis pts 28.5 o -120, reb 10.5 o +100 (StatMuse), pts+reb 39.5 -106 to -120 (Covers); D. Robinson PRA o15.5 -115 (SI best prop, hit 57% last season).
SGP: Cade o9.5 ast (+115) x Giannis o10.5 reb (+100) = implied 0.232 (~+330). True ~0.50 x 0.45 = 0.225, shrunk to 0.22. No edge, not highlighted. Assist/rebound legs chosen over scoring Overs to avoid fighting the Under.
Totals (method, BBR 2025-26): pace DET 99.9, MIA 103.4, avg 101.65. DET = avg(117.3 ORtg, 114.5 MIA DRtg) x 1.0165 = 117.8; MIA = avg(116.7, 108.9) x 1.0165 = 114.7. Total 232.5 vs DK 235.5 (3.0 under; 4-5 under the 236.5-237.5 elsewhere).
Caveat: Miami's ratings predate the Giannis trade (Herro, Ware, Jaquez gone); its opener allowed 131. Detroit lost Harris/Stewart but added Collins, Joe, G. Harris.
Score model: DET +3.1 before home court; with ~2 for Miami, DET by ~1, matching DK -1.5. No side edge.
Experts: SI DET -1.5, total 237.5, top prop Robinson PRA; Bleacher Nation MIA +1.5; Sportsmole DET +1.5 (sic); Dimers MIA -1.5 value (4.7% edge); Covers prices DET ~55% vs Polymarket 48%; SportsGambler Under 236.5 -110. Split on the side.
Coaching: Spoelstra ran the fastest pace in 2025-26 (103.4); Bickerstaff's Pistons are physical with rim protection. Detroit plays a 9-10 man rotation (Green 19 off the bench).
Chemistry: Miami is two games into the Giannis/Adebayo pairing; Mitchell runs point (11 ast in the opener). Detroit's core is intact from a 60-22 season.
Most likely winner: D. Robinson o15.5 PRA (low line, starting role, fast opponent). Best price value: Cade o9.5 assists at +115.
